item.description: ### Added - **Markdown-First Studio**: Continuous TextKit 2 Markdown editor with live two-way slide stage synchronization and single-slide focus mode (`⇧⌘E`). - **3-Phase Code Walkthroughs**: Animated `@code` diff choreography with token anchoring and callouts. - **Hand-Drawn Callouts & Diagrams**: Tapered ink-brush callouts (`^[...]`), interactive 3D isometric diagrams, and Mermaid flowcharts. - **Live Window & Simulator Projection**: Embed live macOS application windows (`@live-window`) and iOS Simulators (`@live-simulator`) directly inside slides. - **Presenter Display & Teleprompter**: Dual-display presenter view, windowed rehearsal mode (`⇧⌘W`), and voiceover narration. - **QuickLook & Finder Thumbnails**: Native macOS `.limelight` QuickLook preview and Finder icon thumbnails.
